captionDescriptionClassic: The original. Karaoke highlight, no motion.
captionDescriptionPop: Heavy uppercase block. Each word pops as it lands.
captionDescriptionPulse: One to three words at a time, oversized, building word by word.
captionDescriptionGlide: Words rise and fade in. Sentence case, no outline.

elementGuidanceModel: 3–5 images. Vary angle (include one three-quarter), lighting, day. Keep constant the person; at least one frame with the face large.
elementGuidanceCharacter: 3–5 images. Vary angle and distance; include one full-body and one back or three-quarter-rear. Keep constant the costume.
elementGuidanceProduct: 3–6 images. Vary angle — front, three-quarter, back, top; include one on a plain ground. Keep constant the exact SKU and colourway.
elementGuidanceObject: 3–6 images. Vary angle, distance. Keep constant the unit.
elementGuidanceMaterial: 2–4 images. Vary lighting, which patch of the surface. Keep constant the material and its scale.
elementGuidanceSetting: 3–5 images. Vary vantage point; time of day only if the place still reads the same. Keep constant the place.
elementGuidanceLocation: 3–5 images. Vary vantage point and distance. Keep constant the spatial landmarks and materials.
elementGuidanceLandscape: 3–5 images. Vary vantage point and scale. Keep constant the terrain, vegetation and atmosphere.
elementGuidanceStyle: 6–8 images. Vary the subject — deliberately different things. Keep constant the treatment.
elementGuidanceMoodboard: 5–8 images. Vary everything except the feeling. Keep constant —.
elementGuidancePalette: 3–6 images. Vary where the colours appear. Keep constant the colour relationships.
elementGuidanceAnimation: 4–8 images. Vary time through the motion. Keep constant the subject and motion path.
elementGuidanceEffect: 4–8 images. Vary onset through dissipation. Keep constant the effect identity.
elementGuidanceGeneral: 3–5 images. Vary framing and setting. Keep constant the subject.
elementInputGuidance: 3–5 varied images beat 8 similar ones. Add another only if it shows something the others don’t.
elementStyleInputGuidance: Use images of different things in the same style — that’s how we tell the style apart from the subject.
elementGuidelinesGuidance: Optional. Call out what the images don’t make obvious — a detail to keep, or which of two variants this is.
elementRightsGuidance: Required for people. Where do these images come from? (e.g. “own employee, consent on file”, “licensed stock, Getty #12345”)
elementApprovedSheetGuidance: The approved sheet is what gets sent to the model.
